notes: Score-panel ornaments, one atlas (rects are [x, y, w, h] in source px). Divider: divider_l + divider_mid repeated + divider_c + divider_mid repeated + divider_r (a rule with a diamond in the middle). corner_tl/tr/bl/br: 16x16 amber brackets for the corners of a panel. pip_on/pip_off: rating and counter diamonds. laurel_l/laurel_r: a wreath either side of the score number. seal: a rosette medal with ribbon tails and a blank centre for a rank glyph. banner_l + banner_mid repeated + banner_r: a steel ribbon behind the ending title. Amber on transparent; tint only if you must.
